title: MCAP guides and format introduction
summary: Primary guide to the MCAP container, including timestamped heterogeneous messages, embedded schemas, efficient seeking and language SDKs. Use it to separate the storage container from the payload encoding.
key_takeaways: Record explicit message schemas and timestamps
A container does not establish sensor clock synchronization or coordinate transforms

title: Rosbags documentation: read and convert ROS bags without ROS
summary: Official Python documentation with AnyReader examples for ROS 1 and ROS 2 recordings, conversion commands and message-type registration. The library has no dependency on a ROS installation.
key_takeaways: Filter connections before deserializing the needed topics
Use the matching type store when message definitions are not embedded

title: Rerun overview and multimodal robotics data guide
summary: Official introduction to SDK logging, synchronized spatial and time-series views, coordinate transforms, timelines and MCAP ingestion for robotics recordings.
key_takeaways: Inspect estimated trajectories alongside sensor streams and scalar health signals
Declare coordinate frames and timeline origins explicitly
